code_conventions: CLI port parsing now extracts the leading signed ASCII decimal prefix after trimStart with DECIMAL_PORT_PREFIX_PATTERN and coerces that prefix with Number. Original radix-10 prefix/trailing-text, signed-zero and error ordering semantics were measured on 100,957 cases per runtime and 13 actual CLI cases.

Replay uses standard Array.fromAsync to await each original runReplayInput operation sequentially; matching transcript writes and focused reader tests also use this native sequential API. No parallel dispatch or custom replay result shape is introduced.

Stream open/drain use one explicit Promise.withResolvers deferred per original awaited operation, preserving original once(open/drain) and once(error) listener lifetime. Open resolves the actual file descriptor internally; its void-returning helper discards that value. Drain resolves its original no-argument event. No additional tracked Promise or operation is introduced.

Stream end uses standard util.promisify around a void-returning onEnd adapter because WritableStream.end returns the stream. This preserves the original callback error envelope including ERR_STREAM_ALREADY_FINISHED on repeated close and ENOSPC. The descriptive callback remains an actual callback, with no rule suppression or altered effective configuration.
The existing server lifetime Promise constructor is replaced with Promise.withResolvers<never>().promise to express the same intentionally never-settling operation.

The transcript remaining-lines adapter forwards only next, honestly awaiting its original Promise, and intentionally omits return to retain caller-owned iterator lifetime. Sync iterator adaptation also honestly awaits its original Promise.resolve result.

Live output uses a private predicate for its existing 14 rendered event kinds and a shared matching-line finisher, preserving ignored canonical event types and exact output formatting while satisfying exhaustive switch/complexity rules.
The CLI/headless test helper now uses a completely validated local HeadlessOutputRecord interface and guards while returning the exact parsed object, preserving key order and additional event fields.
CLI test subprocess completion uses native events.once(close) with an unknown exit-code result narrowed to number|null, preserving close-after-pipe completion and original spawn-error rejection.
